records.groupTitle: Proportion Of Resident Females Among Managers And Administrators
records.title: Proportion Of Resident Females Among Managers And Administrators, Annual
records.footnote: Data refer to employed residents (i.e. Singapore citizens and permanent residents) in the Singapore Standard Occupational Classification (SSOC) 2020 Sub-Major Groups 11 to 13 in June of reference year. Data are used for SDG 5.5.2 'Proportion of women in managerial positions'. Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 5.5.2.
